{{Quote|I want you and Anakin to find C'baoth and ask to go along with him. Not all the way to the next galaxy. Just through the Unknown Regions part of the exploration.''"<br />"''That could take months. I have work to do on Sulorine.|Mace Windu and Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="Outbound" />}}
'''Sulorine''' was an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] celestial body located in the [[Suolriep sector/Legends|Suolriep sector]]. [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] was tasked with an assignment on Suolriep; however, before he could travel there from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] instead gave him another mission, one involving joining the [[Outbound Flight Project|voyage]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Scout/Legends|exploration]] and [[Colonist/Legends|colonization]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Outbound Flight]]''.

==Description==
Sulorine was a terrestrial celestial body<ref name="Outbound" /> located in the [[Sulorine system/Legends|Sulorine system]], a part of the [[Suolriep sector/Legends|Suolriep sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="TEA Sulorine" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" />

==History==
{{Quote|This is a surprise, Master Kenobi. I thought you'd be on your way back to Sulorine by now.''"<br />"''I was relieved of that assignment.|Jorus C'baoth and Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="Outbound" />}}
[[File:Obi-Wanoutboundflight.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Obi-Wan Kenobi's mission on Sulorine was changed to an assignment aboard the starship ''Outbound Flight''.]]
In [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of [[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']] to [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]].</ref> [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] was tasked with an assignment on Sulorine. However, before he could leave [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]],<ref name="Outbound" /> the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]],<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] instead re-assigned Kenobi and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] student, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], to temporarily join the [[Outbound Flight Project|voyage]] of the Republic [[Scout/Legends|exploration]] and [[Colonist/Legends|colonization]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Outbound Flight]]''. Upon hearing the news, Kenobi briefly protested that the delay involved would interfere with his mission to Sulorine but ultimately agreed to take up the new assignment.<ref name="Outbound" />

Later, while the ''Outbound Flight'' was preparing to begin its voyage from the planet [[Yaga Minor/Legends|Yaga Minor]], Kenobi met Jedi Master [[Jorus C'baoth]], leader of the ''Outbound Flight''{{'s}} mission, aboard the composite vessel's [[Dreadnaught-One|command ship]]. Upon encountering Kenobi, C'baoth&mdash;with whom the Jedi Knight had previously undertaken a shared [[Mission to Barlok|mission]] to the planet [[Barlok/Legends|Barlok]]&mdash;expressed his surprise that, by that point, the other [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] had not already traveled to Sulorine, leading Kenobi to briefly explain the situation.<ref name="Outbound" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|''Sulorine'' is indeed a typo for Suolriep, but Obi-Wan Kenobi refers to Sulorine in Outbound Flight, which seemed like enough to let it really exist.|Jason Fry|<ref name="JCF">{{JCFCite|url=posts/30387023|board=Literature|thread=The Essential Atlas and Galactic Cartography: Official Discussion|user=[[Jason Fry|jasonfry]]|date=2009-08-28|time=11:05 PM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20200802104427/https://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-essential-atlas-and-galactic-cartography-official-discussion.21938930/page-109#post-30387023}}</ref>}}
Sulorine was mentioned in the [[2006]] novel [[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']] by [[Timothy Zahn]].<ref name="Outbound" /> The [[1997]] [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' sourcebook ''[[Secrets of the Sisar Run]]'',<ref name="Sisar">''[[Secrets of the Sisar Run]]''</ref> which erroneously referred to the previously established Suolriep [[Sector/Legends|sector]]<ref name="AIR">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref> as the "Sulorine sector," also placed the Sulorine [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the celestial body, relatively close to the region known as the [[Periphery/Legends|Periphery]].<ref name="Sisar" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', however, with its authors [[Daniel Wallace]] and<ref name="TEA" /> [[Jason Fry]] recognizing the typo,<ref name="JCF" /> overrode the information from ''Secrets of the Sisar Run'' by placing the [[Suolriep system/Legends|Suolriep system]] in the Periphery's vicinity and placing the Sulorine system in grid square S-7, further to the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] north.<ref name="TEA" />
